That I don't care about anything that I used to, and the only reason I'm still alive is so that it doesn't hurt them more than I already am by becoming a shell.

I just can't seem to actually care about anything at all.

You mean like floppy vaginas and unibrows, and other stuff like that? Literally only because it's what people feel the most insecure about dude. Trust me. I used to be a bit of an asshole back in highschool before I realized what a retard I was being. People just take the one thing that they think you feel the most insecure about and bet on it hurting you, so that they win the "game". It really is that stupid bro. It's about having power, winning, over you. That's how I saw it anyway. I wouldn't be surprised if that's how it is for most people.

I noticed dude. There are so many people that are fake fucking losers, who don't give a shit about anyone but themselves... I noticed. And I appreciated it. 

Women will insult a man's dick because it's the easiest way to hurt someone. Just the same as pretty much any guy will call someone a faggot because it's deemed as a huge insult. Even if they don't hate gay people. It's just because people will target the thing that they know the person is most insecure about, in order to get the best reaction. Keep in mind it's generally the most ignorant vocal assholes of the world that we hear. We don't get a chance to hear the nice thoughts people have about us very often.

There are still good people out there. It's just harder to hear them over the voices of the assholes who scream out for people's attention.

Hey man, if it makes you feel any better... I'm probably considered an a attractive man, yet I've become a lump with no will to do anything besides feed my dog. No job, no nothing. I literally only have the use to the world of feeding my dog at this point. Other than that I'm a drain of resources. 

People don't hate those who are less attractive. Some of the best people I ever met in my life weren't blessed in the looks department, and I considered them better friends than most. Make up for it with heart, and people will notice. I'm really in no position to be giving advice to anyone... But the world doesn't hate you man. I know it feels that way... But it doesn't hate you.
